key_insight: A neuro-symbolic AI system can automatically abstract complex pathology quality measures from narrative reports with performance comparable to trained human abstractors.
clinical_relevance: If validated broadly, this could reduce manual reporting burden and make large-scale, clinically meaningful quality measurement more feasible in pathology workflows.
method: Decomposed each quality measure into atomic questions.
Used large language model extraction plus symbolic reasoning.
Refined the system with case-based, human-in-the-loop alignment on real reports.
evidence_signal: In 2,000 independently double-abstracted pathology reports, the system matched or slightly exceeded trained human abstractors versus the adjudicated gold standard (kappa 0.95 vs 0.92).
watch_item: Performance was evaluated on a defined set of CAP pathology measures, so broader generalizability and deployment reliability still need external validation.
paper_title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Automated Pathology Quality Measurement
